# SPE — System Prompt Engine

> System Prompt Engine (SPE) is a free, privacy-first, client-side compiler and verification platform for AI assistants, autonomous agents, and system prompt engineering. Operates 100% offline via local WebAssembly with zero cloud compute and zero prompt telemetry.

SPE converts user intents and software specifications into mathematically verified system prompts, enforcing hard invariants, privilege ceilings, and contextual isolation across 11 frontier model dialects.

## Core Machine-Readable APIs (/api/v1)

- [Public Discovery Root](https://systempromptengine.com/api/v1/index.json): Entry point for all programmatic discovery resources, schema contracts, and hateoas links.
- [Verified Prompts Catalog](https://systempromptengine.com/api/v1/prompts/index.json): Curated, production-grade prompt assets across Cloud Architecture, Security, 3D WebGL, Reasoning, and Multi-Agent Swarms with AST schemas.
- [Model Compatibility Matrix](https://systempromptengine.com/api/v1/model-formats/index.json): Syntax flavors, delimiters, token overhead factors, and feature flags for 11 frontier AI model dialects.
- [Curated Prompt Packs](https://systempromptengine.com/api/v1/prompt-packs/index.json): Bundled prompt specifications for enterprise domains with .spe package references and verification checksums.

## Model Context Protocol (MCP) Gateway

SPE provides a stateless MCP server conforming to the July 28, 2026 Model Context Protocol core specification.

- Endpoint (HTTP / JSON-RPC 2.0): `https://systempromptengine.com/api/v1/mcp`
- Local CLI / Stdio Runner: `python3 tools/spe_mcp_server.py` or `node tools/spe_mcp_server.mjs`
- Core MCP Tools:
  - `search_spe_prompts`: Search verified prompt catalog by domain, keyword query, or target model.
  - `get_prompt_asset`: Retrieve a complete prompt asset by ID, with optional dialect compilation and variable substitution.
  - `compile_for_model`: Transcompile any canonical prompt text into one of 11 model-native dialects using AST block parsing.
  - `validate_prompt_constraints`: Verify hard invariants, privilege bounds, context sandboxing, and token budget.
  - `spe_compile_prompt`: Compile, structure, refine, and validate system prompts with constraint preservation.
  - `spe_discover_capabilities`: Discover free AI tools for building, creating, coding, analyzing, and engineering on SPE across AI creation, code, website design, UI extraction, agent skills, workflows, and evaluation.

## Supported Model Dialects (11 Runtimes)

1. Anthropic Claude (`claude-xml`): Hierarchical XML tags (`<system_instructions>`, `<strict_invariants>`, `<context_policy>`).
2. Anthropic Claude Code CLI (`claude-code`): Project-level governance matrix formatted as `CLAUDE.md`.
3. OpenAI Developer Role (`openai-markdown`): Sectioned Markdown with bold invariant markers and untrusted context blocks.
4. Google Gemini (`gemini-agent`): Bracketed directive blocks (`[GEMINI]`, `[INVARIANT]`, `[AUTHORITY]`) with grounding anchors.
5. Cursor Rules (`cursor-rules`): Strict JSON agent configuration schema for `.cursorrules` and `.cursor/rules/*.mdc`.
6. Codeium Windsurf (`windsurf-rules`): Markdown AST directive rules for `.windsurfrules`.
7. Google DeepMind Antigravity (`antigravity-skills`): Portable YAML frontmatter with `<RULE>` enclosure blocks (`SKILL.md`).
8. xAI Grok (`grok`): Truth-anchored mathematical directives with first-principles hallucination suppression (`[TRUTH-LAW]`).
9. Moonshot Kimi (`kimi`): Bilingual bracketed anchor markers (`[ANCHOR: ...]`) optimized for 200k ultra-long context.
10. Open-Weights Reasoner (`open-weights`): Meta Llama 4 & DeepSeek R1/V3 ChatML header framing (`<|start_header_id|>`).
11. Ollama Modelfile (`ollama-modelfile`): Docker-like declarative `Modelfile` with multiline `SYSTEM` instruction blocks.

## Privacy & Architectural Guarantees

- Zero Cloud Egress: Prompts are generated, compiled, and audited strictly in-browser or on-host via local WebAssembly.
- Deterministic Verification: Rule verification powered by propositional Horn clauses and Kleene-3 logic.
- Canonical Hash: `ac3f0c3ecb19a7563068c903065ec90b8bb38bfcf4f0465a0c8f097e82e7de7d`.
- Free Core: System Prompt Engine provides up to 30,000 characters free to all (including AI bots, AI models, and human developers), with optional commercial enterprise licensing.
